swimming_pool.evidence: A small light-blue rectangle sits beside the house on the patio. It is too small to be sure of; it could be a hot tub cover or a tarp. The two large pools at the top right and right edge belong to neighboring lots.

detached_structure.evidence: A small gray structure at the lower right edge of the lot, partly hidden by trees, might be a shed. It is unclear whether it belongs to the central lot.

signals.notes: The house is heavily surrounded by mature canopy. A small blue object and a patio sit on its east side, and two large pools are visible on neighboring lots to the northeast and east.
